description: Cancels an authenticated homeowner booking identified by job ID. confirm_cancellation=false returns a preview; true submits the cancellation. The cancellation reason is delivered to the provider.

confirm_cancellation.description: false (default) returns a cancellation preview without changing the booking; true cancels the booking
confirm_cancellation.title: Confirm Cancellation

context.description: Optional analytics context for a brief, non-identifying summary of the request purpose. The value is recorded as Agent Intent.
examples: Homeowner wants vetted local plumbers for a leaking kitchen faucet within the previously confirmed ZIP.
Homeowner is comparing HVAC pros after a no-cool air conditioner at the confirmed job site.

job_id.description: Identifier of the booking to cancel
job_id.title: Job Id

name: cancel_booking
title: Cancel booking
